title: avrOSdb DAP configuration
description: Configuration fields for an `avrosdb` debug session in Zed's .zed/debug.json. On `launch`, Zed spawns `avrOSdb --dap --port <port> <serial> <elf>` and connects over TCP; on `attach`, Zed connects to an already-running server.

request.description: launch: spawn avrOSdb and connect. attach: connect to a running server.

program.description: Path to the avrOSdb binary to launch. Defaults to `avrOSdb` on PATH. (launch only)

serial.description: Serial device connected to the target's UPDI pin. (launch only)

elf.description: ELF to debug; its DWARF drives source and variables. (launch only)

port.description: TCP port the avrOSdb --dap server listens on.

host.description: IPv4 address of the avrOSdb --dap server.

server.description: Optional `host:port` of an externally-started server; forces connect-only (no spawn).

extraArgs.description: Extra avrOSdb flags inserted before the serial/elf operands, e.g. ["--baud","230400"]. (launch only)

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned avrOSdb server. (launch only)
